column1: # Freshness relation — the SOURCE this derivation was made against.
# A lineage stamp says where an artifact came from; only a hash
# comparison says whether the source has MOVED since. FRESHNESS is also the
# tuple manifest and is published LAST, after atomic replacement of all three
# data members: OBLIGATIONS, UNOBSERVABLE-ADDED-ROSTER and SC-509C-UNPROVED.
